rules.statement: A gift of land made to a prospective bride in contemplation of marriage must be returned if the marriage fails, even through the fault of the donor.
rules.supporting_quote: But it would seem clear that where a man makes a gift of land to his prospective bride in contemplation of marriage, the intention of the parties would be that the gift shall be returned if the marriage fails to take place even through the fault of the donor.

meta.parties: Heen Banda v. Sinniah Et Al
